svg.title: LakeDB Beta 7.2 roadmap
svg.desc: Released SQL, QuerIA and four-engine foundations; current structure-first comparison and explorer refresh; planned compatibility, accessibility and distribution work toward 1.0. Future stages have no fixed dates.

g.text: Built around real database work. Visible review before execution.
Permanent gates: privacy, explicit execution, safe editing and verified packages.
Future stages are direction, not promised scope or dates.
